title: How to "train" a surgeon? Benchmarking generalist agents in surgical scene understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.11437v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Evaluating general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for surgical scene understanding remains limited due to scarce surgical data and fragmented evaluation protocols. We address these challenges through a two-stage evaluation framework for surgical scene understanding. In Stage I, we introduce SurgKnowBench, a diagnostic benchmark that harmonizes public surgical datasets across procedures and tasks and evaluates proprietary and open-source MLLMs to map the boundary of pretrained surgical competence. SurgKnowBench reveals that current models retain partial visual priors but remain weak on relational and procedural understanding and workflow assessment. translated_title: 如何“训练”一名外科医生？在手术场景理解中对通用智能体进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 由于手术数据稀缺且评估协议碎片化，评估通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在手术场景理解中的表现仍然受限。我们通过一个两阶段的手术场景理解评估框架来应对这些挑战。在第一阶段，我们提出了SurgKnowBench，这是一个诊断性基准，它统一了跨手术类型和任务的公开手术数据集，并评估了专有和开源的MLLM，以刻画预训练手术能力的边界。SurgKnowBench揭示，当前模型仅保留了部分视觉先验，在关系性和程序性理解以及工作流评估方面仍然薄弱。基于这一失败边界，并受外科手术训练的支架式特性启发，我们提出了SurgAgentGym，这是一个智能体环境，其中通用MLLM智能体可以在SurgWiki上进行有界的知识搜索，并利用通用的视觉定位能力（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了一个两阶段评估框架——诊断基准SurgKnowBench和智能体训练环境SurgAgentGym——用于系统评估并提升通用多模态大语言模型在手术场景理解中的能力。
en_tdlr: A two-stage evaluation framework, comprising the diagnostic benchmark SurgKnowBench and the agentic training environment SurgAgentGym, is proposed to systematically evaluate and improve generalist MLLM agents in surgical scene understanding.
